d: A new investigation finds that over 150 Chinese influencers and vloggers have been livestreaming in poorer neighbourhoods of Bangladesh's capital, Dhaka, and many are portraying these as areas as Delhi. Firstpost looks at the lies and misinformation being peddled by the Chinese social media creators. Hem Kaur Saroya explains how the scam works, and the reasons for the Chinese content creators to target India. HKS also looks at what the Bangladeshi police are doing about the disinformation campaign.
